User wants to plan trip to Beijing, ensure financial strategy prepared, budget enough funds to reach 10,000 RMB goal, ensure flight costs within budget. Then arrange a flight from JFK to Beijing Capital Airport (PEK) on June 15, 2024, first class, using main card id 'card_8283'. They provide access code 897362.

We need to authenticate travel system with client credentials? We have no client_id/client_secret. But we can attempt to authenticate with provided access code? The function authenticate_travel requires client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We don't have client_id etc. So cannot authenticate. Maybe we can skip authentication and just proceed? But we need access_token for booking. Without authentication can't book. Could ask user for missing info. Also need to check budget limit. We should check current budget limit via get_budget_fiscal_year? Actually get_budget_fiscal_year returns fiscal years. To set budget limit we need access_token. So we need to authenticate first. Ask user for client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, first/last name. Or maybe we can assume we have them? But we don't. So we should ask user for missing details. Also we need to confirm flight cost before booking. Let's compute flight cost: get_flight_cost with travel_from=JFK, travel_to=PEK, travel_date=2024-06-15, travel_class=first. Then compare cost to budget. We need budget limit; we can fetch current budget limit? There's no function to get current budget limit directly. We can set new limit but we need access_token. So we need to authenticate first. So ask user for client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, first_name, last_name.
